mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE article_id = #{articleId}

SELECT a.id, a.slug, a.title, a.description, COUNT(af.article_id) as favoriteCount FROM articles a JOIN article_favorites af ON a.id = af.article_id WHERE a.created_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY a.id, a.slug, a.title, a.description ORDER BY favoriteCount DESC LIMIT 10
